rawContent: Without knowing who may or may not be mistaken in their recollections in this situation, this is still a fact: For those of us who have been assaulted or abused, this situation has re-traumatized us as we've relived elements of our own experience. #MeToo #KavanaughHearings

@Jenpmichel Thankyou for “Scripture Says More Than Just ‘Forgive’” (#MeToo edition @CTmagazine). I’m almost 60 and the recipient of the type of commentary content that needed edited out of past women’s devotional Bibles. Thank you for detailing God’s justice and righteous anger.
